question: Life appeared on Earth soon after the planet cooled. What does that tell us about how common life is elsewhere?
answer: Very little. Anyone able to ask needed life to start early enough to evolve brains before the Sun grows too hot; a late start would have left nobody to notice. A 2012 analysis showed that, with one example, an early start fits a universe where life is common and one where it is rare.
move: If you could only exist in the lucky case, your luck proves little.
ask: Am I treating my own good luck as proof that the path is easy for everyone?
trap: That life starts easily, since it began here so fast.
